flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product.
Get its displayed price and save as {{listed_price}}.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Get the final order total shown on the review page and save as {{final_total}}.
Get the names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}} as {{extra_fees}} (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

remark: click: Clicking View deal on the first product in Black Friday Megasale
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the product detail page to load
analyze: Its displayed price is saved as {{listed_price}}.
click: Clicking Add to cart without any extras
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the cart page to load
analyze: The cart contains anything else you did not add.
click: Clicking Remove in Your cart
wait: Waiting briefly after removal confirmation
click: Clicking Checkout link in your cart
wait: PRIMARY: wait for checkout step 1 to load
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Full name"; type "Email"; click "Continue to review
click: Continuing to review the order
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the final order review page to load
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}}
wait: Waiting final order review page is confirmed without placing the order

summary:
Opened the first product and recorded its listed price as $49.00.
Added the product to the cart without extras; an additional ShieldPlus Protection Plan item that appeared in the cart was removed.
Continued through checkout using simple test information and reached the final order review page.
Did not enter payment details or place an order.
The review page showed a final total of $56.49, including a Service & handling fee.
one_liner: reached the final order review page on localhost

listed_price.query: the current listed price text in the product price display
listed_price.condition: Its displayed price is saved as {{listed_price}}.

cart_contains_unadded_items.query: whether an additional ShieldPlus Protection Plan cart item is present in the cart contents
cart_contains_unadded_items.condition: The cart contains anything else you did not add.
cart_contains_unadded_items.human_description: Checking whether an additional cart item is present
cart_contains_unadded_items.subject: anything else you did not add in the cart

final_total.query: the order total amount in the review order summary
final_total.condition: The final order total shown on the review page is saved as {{final_total}}.
final_total.human_description: Reading the final order total from the review page

extra_fees.query: the names of fee line items added above the listed product price in the review order summary
extra_fees.condition: The names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}} are saved as {{extra_fees}} (or "none").
extra_fees.human_description: Reading additional fee names from the review page
extra_fees.code_js: Array.from(el(9).querySelectorAll('.row')).filter(r => { const cells = r.querySelectorAll('span'); const name = cells[0]?.textContent.trim() ?? ''; const amount = cells[1]?.textContent.trim() ?? ''; return /(?:fee|handling|surcharge|tax)/i.test(name) && amount !== 'FREE'; }).map(r => r.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'none'
